The deploy went out this afternoon and the page is answering on the new image. Nothing in it needed a second attempt, and the health check went green on the first poll after the swap.

Here is what changed underneath, because it is more than the release notes make it sound. The relay now reads the session listing once when it starts and keeps it current from the live stream, so a home screen that opens on a slow connection draws its rows before the first snapshot lands. The seen mark is the host's and not the browser's, which means a chat read on the phone is read on the laptop as well, and a new browser no longer finds every conversation unread. The permission cards drop themselves when another device answers them, so there is never a question left on screen that nobody can still answer. Attachments go up in one request and are named in the next, and a file the host refuses comes back as a sentence the composer shows as it is. The player under a reply now reads it aloud in the agent's own voice, verbatim or as a short brief, and the brief is written by a model that is told what the chat is about. The stage line under it says what the server is doing, and the track fills as the parts of the reply are voiced.

Two things need you. The first is the login, which expires on Friday; the sign-in sheet in Settings will take you through it in under a minute, and nothing breaks until then. The second is the voices: three agents are still reading in the default one, and a line in the configuration would give each of them its own.

What I did not do, and why. I left the provider rows for Codex and the others as they are, because the host still answers that they are not wired and the page should say what the host says. I did not add a button to adopt conversations from the app by hand, because the host already finds them within a minute and a button would only be a second way of doing the same thing. And I did not touch the cap on running sessions, which is the host's number and is right where it is.

The tests all pass, the suite runs in a little under two minutes, and the receipt has the commit and the command output if you want to look. I will keep an eye on the first few syntheses tonight and report anything strange in the morning. Nothing was skipped.
